description: A NEW historical RESEARCH distribution layer, built on top of MLB-RSCH-0009's frozen {offense, bullpen} mean model (unchanged). Tests whether Poisson (D0, control) is beaten by an overdispersed negative-binomial (D1) or a correlated bivariate-Poisson (D2) candidate, each with exactly one dev-fit closed-form parameter.
name: mlb_rsch_0010_run_distribution_v1
